description: This file defines the OrderProvider class, which manages order-related operations such as placing orders and refreshing order status within a Flutter app. It interacts with an API client to communicate with a backend service and notifies listeners of state changes.

classes.name: OrderProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages the state of current orders, including placing new orders and updating order status.

methods.name: placeOrder
methods.description: Asynchronously places a new order with specified items, fulfillment method, and payment method, then updates internal state and notifies listeners.

methods.name: refreshStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes the current order status from the backend and updates internal state accordingly.
